content: .{@-कल्पना@} {%f.%} imputing a figurative meaning, one of the modes of interpreting a sentence. According to it an expression may be understood as conveying not what is actually expressed by it but the quality or qualities thereof. {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} सिंहो देवदत्तः means प्रसह्यकरी देवदत्तः; <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 1</ls>.
